audience: course creators and membership sites that sell course access in MemberVault

useCases.title: List courses to find their ids
useCases.text: List the courses of the account with their ids. Use one of those ids in the access changes.

useCases.title: Give a member access to a course
useCases.text: Add a user to a course by email. MemberVault finds an existing user with that email, so a repeat call does not create a duplicate.

useCases.title: Remove course access and keep the member
useCases.text: Remove one course from a user. The user stays in the account, with their other courses and progress.

useCases.title: Delete a member completely
useCases.text: Permanently delete a user with all their data, progress and quiz answers. MemberVault cannot undo this, so confirm with the user first.
